## Is this already on the roadmap?

Please check [ROADMAP.md](../../ROADMAP.md) first — many larger
features (vulnerability scanning, auto-remediation, compliance, threat
intel, etc.) are already planned for a specific future version. If your
request matches one of those, feel free to comment on it here for
discussion, but note it likely won't be implemented until that version's
build phase begins.
